name: external-agents
description: Hands tasks and reviews to other vendors' official coding-agent CLIs (Codex first) through their documented headless surfaces: one skill per CLI, one shared runner with per-use sandbox ceilings, job files and a breaker, and the external-agents command that review:council calls.

antigravity_uses_task_mode.title: Antigravity task mode
antigravity_uses_task_mode.description: read-only (default): /external-agents:antigravity task runs cannot edit files. write: task runs may write, fenced by agy's terminal sandbox, in every repository. A repository's docs/conventions/external-agents.yaml or .local.yaml antigravity.uses.task.mode wins over this option.
